VALORANT

A 5v5 character-based tactical shooter

ABOUT VALORANT //

VALORANT is a free-to-play multiplayer first-person shooter developed by Riot Games. Set in the near-future Earth, a global event known as First Light changed the world, bringing massive shifts to life, technology, and government operations.

Some humans gained superhuman abilities during this event, and they are known as Radiants. This means they rely not just on guns, but on unique abilities to turn the tide of battle. In this high-stakes, high-reward competitive arena, every round is full of variables, and precise gunplay combined with unexpected skill combinations is the key to victory.

\\ VALORANT PROTOCOL

Following the First Light event, a shadow organization was formed, known as the VALORANT Protocol. This organization gathered agents from around the globe, including Radiants with superpowers and ordinary humans equipped with cutting-edge technology.

Each agent has a unique tactical role: Duelists, Initiators, Controllers, and Sentinels. Their goal is to face the unknown threats brought by First Light and protect the future of Earth. In this team, no two battles are ever the same.

Learn About Agents

MAPS & LOCATIONS //

Every map is not only a battleground but also a testament to how First Light changed the world. From the Moroccan facilities of Bind to the airborne city of Ascent, each location is meticulously designed.

Here, you must use unique map mechanics (such as one-way teleporters or destructible blast doors) to formulate strategies. Exploring different battlefields and mastering the details of every inch of land will give you and your team a massive advantage.
